subject: Azure co-sell: seller linkup + account mapping for Contoso (marketplace)
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Azure co-sell: Contoso marketplace — proposed seller linkup and account map

Team,

Contoso just accepted our Partner Center referral for a marketplace listing pilot. They want the marketplace listing + co-sell alignment to move in parallel. Key asks from Contoso: seller contact for co-sell registration, which account(s) we plan to stitch to their tenant, and a short intake runbook so their GTM/MP ops know the handoff.

Can we align on two things today:
- A primary field seller (MSFT-facing) person we’ll pass to Contoso for co-sell enablement
- A preliminary account map (top 25 accounts by ARR) that we will propose for co-sell consent

I started a CSV with the first-pass account list (attached). Vanessa — can you nominate the seller contact and confirm if we need any redlines on the consent process? Karthik — can you run the account match vs our territory list and mark any ownership conflicts? Neha — please draft a 1-page intake playbook for Contoso MP ops (what they expect, what we need).

Timelines: Contoso wants this by end of day so they can schedule their marketplace onboarding next week. I realize tight — let’s triage.

Thanks,
David
David Kim | Sales Lead, Cloud GTM | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: contoso-account-map-v1.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Contoso marketplace — proposed seller linkup and account map

David — thanks for pulling this together.

Primary seller: assigning Maria Alvarez (maria.alvarez@microsoft.com) as the MSFT field contact — she’s the seller who owns Contoso vertical at MSFT and has done co-sell for other marketplace pilots. I’ll intro to Contoso after we confirm the account set.

Quick notes on consent: MSFT co-sell consent window is standard — Contoso will need to add our app to their Partner Center listing and accept consent per tenant. No unusual redlines from our side but we should flag any accounts with existing OEM relationships (I marked likely candidates in the CSV).

I reviewed the CSV and added an additional column (ownership_flag) where I tagged 'shared' for accounts that have programmatic overlap with other reps. See attachment.

I suggest we:
- Finalize a 25-account candidate list (accepting shared accounts if owner agrees)
- Get Contoso to sign the MP intake (I attached a draft playbook)
- Schedule a 30-min alignment with Maria + Contoso MP ops (propose Tue 10am PT)

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Americas | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: contoso-account-map-v1.csv (updated), contoso-intake-playbook-draft.pdf (5 pages)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Contoso marketplace — proposed seller linkup and account map

Adding mapping notes after running the account list against our territory ledger:

- Confirmed owners: 16 accounts map cleanly to our assigned sellers. I added owner initials in the CSV.
- Contested: 6 accounts are covered by field reps in EMEA/APAC or are in cross-product accounts; recommend we route these to the owner for opt-in before we include in the co-sell list.
- Orphans: 3 accounts show no recent activity; recommend we exclude from the initial 25 and keep as a holdback for phase 2.

Operational asks:
1) Vanessa — can Maria be copied on the hubspot deal (deal id RW-ACME-3421) so she has visibility?
2) Neha — please add a short decision tree to the playbook for contested account escalation (owner opts-in / owner declines / no response).

I attached a version of the CSV with owner initials and the suggested 25-account slug. If everyone is good, I’ll lock the list and we can share it with Contoso for consent checks.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@contoso.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Contoso Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@contoso.com>, Maria Alvarez <maria.alvarez@microsoft.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Contoso marketplace — proposed seller linkup and account map

Hi David / Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We reviewed the 25 candidate accounts and the playbook looks good. A few items before we lock: 

- We need Maria on the HubSpot deal so co-sell can be attached on our side (I copied her).
- For the 6 contested accounts, Contoso MP ops requests owner confirmation workflow; please send us the final list once owners are confirmed.
- Quick ask: can you provide the expected timeline for consent completion (per-tenant) so our MP ops can schedule resources?

We can meet Tue 10am PT — confirmed from our side.

Best,
Jane Doe
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Contoso
jane.doe@contoso.com

Forwarded-For-Records: Contoso MP intake form link: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/MP/Intake/RW-ACME-3421
